evidence.required_frontage_band: required minimum lot frontage of 18.0 metres or less

calculation_handling.description: Where the required minimum lot frontage is 18.0 m or less, a residential building may be at most 17.0 m long.

evidence.required_frontage_band: required minimum lot frontage of more than 12.0 metres to 18.0 metres

calculation_handling.description: Optional one-storey rear extension of a detached house of up to 2.0 m beyond the maximum building length (on lots with required frontage over 12.0 m up to 18.0 m): the extended part may be at most 5.0 m high and one storey. The 2.0 m extension length is the stem's permission, recorded under literals_not_expressed as the shared stem value.
calculation_handling.gaps: The one-storey limit on the extended part is a second measure (storeys) not expressible on this single height_m target; whether the extension is used is a design choice.

evidence.required_frontage_band: required minimum lot frontage of more than 12.0 metres to 18.0 metres

calculation_handling.description: The extended part may be no wider than 50% of the building's width at its widest point.
calculation_handling.gaps: Whether the extension is used is a design choice.

evidence.required_frontage_band: required minimum lot frontage of more than 12.0 metres to 18.0 metres

calculation_handling.description: The extended part must be at least 3.0 m from each side lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies to the extended part only, not the whole house; whether the extension is used is a design choice.

evidence.depth_band: lot depth of 36.0 metres or greater
evidence.frontage_band: lot frontage of less than 10.0 metres

calculation_handling.description: A detached houseplex may be up to 19.0 m long on a lot at least 36.0 m deep with frontage under 10.0 m.

evidence.depth_band: lot depth of 40.0 metres or greater
evidence.frontage_band: lot frontage of 10.0 metres or greater

calculation_handling.description: A detached houseplex may be up to 19.0 m long on a lot at least 40.0 m deep with frontage of 10.0 m or more.
On a lot abutting a major street, a townhouse may be up to 19.0 m long.
calculation_handling.gaps: Requires a major-street abutment test for the lot.

calculation_handling.description: On a lot abutting a major street, an apartment building may be up to 25.0 m long.
calculation_handling.gaps: Apartment buildings are outside MaxBLD building types.

units.disclosure: An apartment building on a major street may be up to 25.0 m long. We do not model apartment buildings, so this limit is not evaluated.

10.20.40.20(1).explanation: In the RD zone, where the required minimum lot frontage is 18.0 m or less, a residential building may be at most 17.0 m long.

10.20.40.20(2).explanation: Where the required frontage is over 12.0 m and up to 18.0 m, a detached house may extend up to 2.0 m beyond the length limit. The extension must be one storey and no more than 5.0 m high, no wider than half the house's widest point, and at least 3.0 m from each side lot line.

10.20.40.20(3).explanation: A detached houseplex may be up to 19.0 m long if the lot is at least 36.0 m deep with frontage under 10.0 m, or at least 40.0 m deep with frontage of 10.0 m or more.

10.20.40.20(4).explanation: On a lot that abuts a major street, a townhouse may be up to 19.0 m long and an apartment building up to 25.0 m long.
